items.uz: Sizning pozitsiyangizni tushunaman, ammo to'liq qo'shilolmayman.
items.en: I understand your position, but I can't fully agree.

items.uz: Bu masalaning ikkinchi tomoni ham bor.
items.en: This issue has another side too.

items.uz: Aqlli bo'lgani bilan, ba'zan xato qiladi.
items.en: Despite being smart, he/she sometimes makes mistakes.

items.uz: Uning fikri asosli bo'lgani bilan, amaliyotda qiyin.
items.en: Despite his/her opinion being well-founded, it's difficult in practice.

items.uz: Bu bahs hal qilingandek tuyulsa-da, davom etmoqda.
items.en: Even though this debate seems resolved, it continues.

items.uz: Har ikki tomonning dalillari ham e'tiborga loyiq.
items.en: Both sides' arguments are worth considering.

items.uz: Kelishuvga erishishimiz vaqt talab qiladi.
items.en: Reaching an agreement will take time.

items.uz: Sizning bu boradagi tajribangiz muhim ahamiyatga ega.
items.en: Your experience in this matter is of great importance.

items.uz: Men bu masalani boshqacha nuqtai nazardan ko'rib chiqishni taklif qilaman.
items.en: I suggest looking at this issue from a different perspective.

items.uz: Bu bahsning yechimi murakkab bo'lgani bilan, imkonsiz emas.
items.en: Despite the solution to this debate being complex, it isn't impossible.

items.uz: Fikringizni hurmat qilaman, biroq dalillarim boshqacha.
items.en: I respect your opinion, but my evidence differs.

items.uz: Umid qilamanki, oxir-oqibat murosaga kelamiz.
items.en: I hope that in the end we'll reach a compromise.

items.uz: Eshitishimcha, u ishdan ketar emish.
items.en: As I hear, he/she is allegedly leaving the job.

items.uz: Bu gap rost emish, deyishyapti.
items.en: They say this rumor is allegedly true.

items.uz: Men bunga to'liq ishonmayman.
items.en: I don't fully believe this.

items.uz: U hammasini bilgandek gapirdi, ammo unday emas edi.
items.en: He/she spoke as if he/she knew everything, but it wasn't so.

items.uz: Gap-so'zlarga berilmaslik kerak.
items.en: One shouldn't give in to rumors.

items.uz: Aniq manbadan tasdiqlanmaguncha, ishonmayman.
items.en: Until confirmed by a reliable source, I won't believe it.

items.uz: Bu xabar tarqalgani bilan, hali tasdiqlanmagan.
items.en: Despite this news having spread, it hasn't been confirmed yet.

items.uz: Odamlar orasida turli mish-mishlar yuribdi.
items.en: Various rumors are circulating among people.

items.uz: Har doim ham eshitgan gapga ishonavermaslik kerak.
items.en: One shouldn't always believe everything one hears.

items.uz: Bu masala aniqlanguncha xulosa chiqarmaylik.
items.en: Let's not draw conclusions until this matter is clarified.

items.uz: Manba ishonchli emish, lekin tekshirib ko'rish kerak.
items.en: The source is allegedly reliable, but it needs to be checked.

items.uz: Vaqt hammasini oshkor qiladi.
items.en: Time reveals everything.
